title: text_only_repro misses a grep through a pipe, awk or sed over a source file and a test -z of grep
goal: backlog.py text_only_repro also flags a shell pipeline whose only reader of a file is cat or another text filter feeding grep, awk or sed run over a source file, and test -z/-n over a grep's output, so new refuses them without --repro-reason and check warns of them; ST-2lnlt3ir caught only plain grep, rg, findstr, Select-String and python -c text reads. From the SP-5cwekumc review.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import backlog; miss=[a for a in (['sh','-c','cat _tools/x.py | grep -q foo'], ['awk','/foo/{f=1} END{exit !f}','_tools/x.py'], ['sh','-c','test -z "\$(grep -n foo _tools/x.py)"']) if not backlog.text_only_repro(a)]; assert not miss, miss
